integrity: Universal identity has a self-contained indicator proof and separate recursion; independent finite enumerator passed 1567 rational checks. No third-party certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: One distinguished root has positive weight theta and every nonroot vertex weight one; results concern exact covariance, not correlation or a joint weak limit. The uniform-weight theta=1 case is previously known. Possible implicit coverage by older bivariate enumerators remains a priority risk.
title: Sharp root-weight optimum for branch–leaf covariance in Hoppe trees
